tasks.label: Verify jq application log filter
tasks.command: Set-Location 'D:\Desktop\AmaliTech-DEG-Project-based-challenges\dev-ops\WatchTower\app'; $jq = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\jq\jq.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $jq)) { throw 'jq executable was not found at the installed user path.' }; Write-Output 'jq version:'; & $jq --version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'jq version check failed.' }; Write-Output 'Filter syntax example:'; '{"level":"error","service":"order-service","msg":"example error"}' | & $jq -c 'fromjson? | select(.level == "error")'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'jq filter example failed.' }; Write-Output 'Recent order-service logs filtered for error-level JSON:'; $logs = docker compose logs --tail=100 --no-color --no-log-prefix order-service; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not read Compose logs. Check whether Docker is running and the stack is available.' }; $logs | & $jq -c 'fromjson? | select(.level == "error")'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Filtering the order-service Compose logs failed.' }

tasks.label: Inspect jq filtering against service logs
tasks.command: Set-Location 'D:\Desktop\AmaliTech-DEG-Project-based-challenges\dev-ops\WatchTower\app'; $jq = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\jq\jq.exe'; Write-Output 'jq version:'; & $jq --version; Write-Output 'jq filter example:'; '{"level":"error","service":"order-service","msg":"example error"}' | & $jq -c 'select(.level == "error")'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'jq JSON filter example failed.' }; Write-Output 'Recent raw order-service logs:'; $logs = docker compose logs --tail=20 --no-color --no-log-prefix order-service; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not read Compose logs. tasks.label: Verify jq against captured Compose logs
tasks.command: Set-Location 'D:\Desktop\AmaliTech-DEG-Project-based-challenges\dev-ops\WatchTower\app'; $jq = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\jq\jq.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $jq)) { throw 'jq executable was not found.' }; Write-Output 'jq filter self-test:'; & $jq -n '{level:"error",service:"order-service",msg:"example error"} | select(.level == "error")'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'jq filter self-test failed.' }; $logFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'watchtower-order-service-jq-verification.txt'; try { Write-Output 'Capturing recent order-service logs:'; docker compose logs --tail=20 --no-color --no-log-prefix order-service | Out-File -FilePath $logFile -Encoding utf8; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not read Compose logs. Check Docker and stack status.' }; Get-Content -Path $logFile -TotalCount 5; Write-Output 'Applying the README filter:'; & $jq -c 'fromjson? | select(.level == "error")' $logFile; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'README jq filter failed against captured logs.' }; Write-Output 'Applying direct JSON filter for comparison:'; & $jq -c 'select(.level == "error")' $logFile; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Direct jq filter failed against captured logs.' } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $logFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

tasks.label: Run README jq filter on app logs
tasks.command: Set-Location 'D:\Desktop\AmaliTech-DEG-Project-based-challenges\dev-ops\WatchTower\app'; $jq = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\jq\jq.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $jq)) { throw 'jq executable was not found.' }; $logFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'watchtower-order-service-jq-verification.txt'; $filterFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'watchtower-jq-filter-verification.jq'; try { Write-Output 'jq version:'; & $jq --version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'jq version check failed.' }; Write-Output 'Capturing recent order-service logs:'; docker compose logs --tail=20 --no-color --no-log-prefix order-service | Set-Content -LiteralPath $logFile -Encoding Ascii; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not read Compose logs. Check Docker and stack status.' }; Get-Content -LiteralPath $logFile -TotalCount 5; Set-Content -LiteralPath $filterFile -Value 'fromjson? | select(.level == "error")' -Encoding Ascii; Write-Output 'Running the README jq filter against actual logs:'; & $jq -c -f $filterFile $logFile; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'README jq filter failed against captured logs.' }; Set-Content -LiteralPath $filterFile -Value 'select(.level == "error")' -Encoding Ascii; Write-Output 'Running a direct JSON-object filter for comparison:'; & $jq -c -f $filterFile $logFile; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Direct jq filter failed against captured logs.' } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $logFile, $filterFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

tasks.label: Verify direct jq error filtering
tasks.command: Set-Location 'D:\Desktop\AmaliTech-DEG-Project-based-challenges\dev-ops\WatchTower\app'; $jq = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\jq\jq.exe'; $sample = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'watchtower-jq-error-sample.json'; try { Write-Output 'jq version:'; & $jq --version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'jq version check failed.' }; Set-Content -LiteralPath $sample -Value '{"level":"error","service":"order-service","msg":"example error"}' -Encoding Ascii; Write-Output 'Direct filter selects the expected JSON error record:'; & $jq -c 'select(.level == "error")' $sample; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Direct jq filter failed on the JSON test record.' }; Write-Output 'Direct filter against recent order-service logs (empty is expected if there are no errors):'; docker compose logs --tail=20 --no-color --no-log-prefix order-service | & $jq -c 'select(.level == "error")'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Direct jq filter failed against order-service logs.' } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $sample -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

tasks.label: Validate jq filter semantics
tasks.command: Set-Location 'D:\Desktop\AmaliTech-DEG-Project-based-challenges\dev-ops\WatchTower\app'; $jq = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\jq\jq.exe'; $sample = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'watchtower-jq-error-sample.json'; $logs = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'watchtower-order-service-jq-verification.txt'; $filter = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'watchtower-jq-filter-verification.jq'; try { Set-Content -LiteralPath $filter -Value 'select(.level == $level)' -Encoding Ascii; & $jq -n --arg level error --arg service order-service --arg msg 'example error' '{level:$level,service:$service,msg:$msg}' | Set-Content -LiteralPath $sample -Encoding Ascii; Write-Output 'Synthetic expected output:'; Get-Content -LiteralPath $sample; Write-Output 'Filtered synthetic JSON:'; & $jq -c --arg level error -f $filter $sample; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'jq failed to filter the synthetic JSON record.' }; docker compose logs --tail=20 --no-color --no-log-prefix order-service | Set-Content -LiteralPath $logs -Encoding Ascii; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not retrieve recent order-service logs.' }; Write-Output 'Raw application log sample:'; Get-Content -LiteralPath $logs -TotalCount 3; Write-Output 'Filtered actual application logs (expected empty because current logs are info-level):'; & $jq -c --arg level error -f $filter $logs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'jq failed against the actual application logs.' } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $sample, $logs, $filter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
